svg.title: Six architectures · sequence conditioning and scoring
svg.desc: Two rows compare SASRec and HSTU. Dot-product and MoL retain ordinary sequence encoders. Proposed ExpertHistory injects static expert dictionaries inside every block, preserves recent and latent-selected original events, summarizes the full contextual history, and uses three scoring paths per item expert. Shared backbone internals are omitted.
svg.metadata: Proposed architecture, 2026-10-27. Sources: retrieval_model_improvement_plan.md and ../new_similarity_scoring_plan.md. Dimensions describe the design, not a verified implementation. No benchmark executed.
svg.text: Six architectures · where the candidate meets user history
Rows change the backbone. Columns change sequence conditioning, preserved evidence, and the scoring function.
ExpertHistory panels show the proposed revision. Common encoder internals are intentionally omitted.
Ordinary sequence encoder · candidate enters after encoding
The candidate reads one user vector.

ExpertHistory: R = 32 proposed; selected events may overlap recent events. Each latent summary includes the entire contextualized prefix.
